gates.unit: node --test tests/battle-bexar.test.mjs and tests/battle-bexar-view.test.mjs, the named test and no other

unit.name: the men dawdle into the town and are still near the mill when the fighting starts
unit.expect: a yes to Milam walks out of the mill at three and into the town before contact, stands in a division and fights, and cannot be sent away
failed: a yes to Milam walks out of the mill at three and into the town before contact, stands in a division and fights, and cannot be sent away

unit.name: the white flag waits on the reinforcement again
unit.expect: the white flag comes whether or not the camp's companies were ever asked for
failed: the white flag comes whether or not the camp's companies were ever asked for

unit.name: a hit falls on any day alike, not on Johnson's daily losses
unit.expect: a family's man who is hit is hit on a day weighted by Johnson's losses, at a moment inside the fighting, in a phase that fits
failed: a family's man who is hit is hit on a day weighted by Johnson's losses, at a moment inside the fighting, in a phase that fits

unit.name: a man's fall is sent before it happens
unit.expect: killed: he falls at his staged moment where he stands, his family watching sees it then and not before, and is told only when the word comes
failed: killed: he falls at his staged moment where he stands, his family watching sees it then and not before, and is told only when the word comes

unit.name: the town holds the class between episodes whoever is in it
unit.expect: between the episodes the town fights on at two hours a tick while a played family has somebody in it, and not otherwise; never faster
failed: between the episodes the town fights on at two hours a tick while a played family has somebody in it, and not otherwise; never faster

unit.name: the family at home is sent the storming
unit.expect: the Host watches it live and is spotlit on the town for each episode; the family in it and the family at the mill watch; the family at home is sent nothing
failed: the Host watches it live and is spotlit on the town for each episode; the family in it and the family at the mill watch; the family at home is sent nothing

unit.name: the alert comes only once the men are in the streets
unit.expect: the alert comes through the person before each episode, with Watch on the town; the reserve is told what it hears; nobody else is alerted
failed: the alert comes through the person before each episode, with Watch on the town; the reserve is told what it hears; nobody else is alerted

unit.name: the account does not say why it ended as it did
unit.expect: afterwards each family with somebody there is told through that person what happened, what they did and why; the men go home, the wounded stay
failed: afterwards each family with somebody there is told through that person what happened, what they did and why; the men go home, the wounded stay

unit.name: a gun's later shots are sent before they are fired
unit.expect: a page is sent nothing of the storming that has not happened yet
failed: a page is sent nothing of the storming that has not happened yet

unit.name: the mill left a mile out
unit.expect: the storming is staged on the town the map draws: its houses are the assembly's, the mill half a mile north, the Alamo at the east edge
failed: the storming is staged on the town the map draws: its houses are the assembly's, the mill half a mile north, the Alamo at the east edge

unit.name: the men inside the houses drawn standing in the street
unit.expect: in the houses most men are out of sight: the fire is flashes and smoke at the walls, the roofs are manned, and the guns fire their dated shots once each
failed: in the houses most men are out of sight: the fire is flashes and smoke at the walls, the roofs are manned, and the guns fire their dated shots once each

unit.name: the family let out of the house is never drawn
unit.expect: Karnes's door: a man at the bar until it gives, then the hole; the family inside walks out unhurt and never fires
failed: Karnes's door: a man at the bar until it gives, then the hole; the family inside walks out unhurt and never fires

unit.name: Milam is not drawn where he fell
unit.expect: Milam falls in the Veramendi yard at half past three, named, and nobody gives him words
failed: Milam falls in the Veramendi yard at half past three, named, and nobody gives him words

unit.name: no white flag
unit.expect: dawn on the 9th: the guns stop, the bugle is heard, and a white flag comes to the plaza
failed: dawn on the 9th: the guns stop, the bugle is heard, and a white flag comes to the plaza

unit.name: a family's man drawn down before his moment
unit.expect: a family's man stands in his unit and fires with it, and falls at the moment the server staged, not before
failed: a family's man stands in his unit and fires with it, and falls at the moment the server staged, not before

browser.name: the storming drawn as two lines: no group apart from its side
browser.expect: the fight is drawn as two lines
browser.failure: the fight is drawn as two lines, not groups in their houses: {}

browser.name: the men who said yes stay at the mill
browser.expect: the alert came only once the fighting had begun
browser.failure: the alert came only once the fighting had begun

browser.name: the family with nobody there is sent the storming
browser.expect: the family with nobody there was sent the battle
browser.failure: the family with nobody there was sent the battle (first)

browser.name: his own wound is never drawn
Milam's fall is not drawn
browser.expect: Milam was not seen to fall
browser.failure: Milam was not seen to fall in the yard

browser.name: the Host's camera is not sent to the town
browser.expect: the Host's camera was not on the town
browser.failure: the Host's camera was not on the town in the karnes: {"phase":"karnes","focus":"regional","camera":"region","seen":["bexar-entry:97860","bexar-karnes:101160"]}

environment: Same computer: node --test, and a local classroom server with headless Chrome at 1366x768 and 1024x768.
